goalTranslation.businessGoal: A creator turns raw footage into publishable, source-grounded edits without the agent making silent semantic changes or unreviewed renders.

quantifiedTarget.rationale: config/openrouter-free-routing.json thresholds.minimumSuccessRate gates which models the planner may use.

tiers.action: Read-only planning passes against the free router (draft + review plan JSON, no media side effects)
Apply an agent-proposed timeline edit in the browser editor: every mutating tool call becomes a patch card the user must accept before the plan changes
Advance the render workflow past await_review toward freeze/publish: the stage row is patched to awaiting_approval (convex/workflow.ts:266) and only approveReview resumes it
Execute a compiled recipe whose intent sets requireHumanApproval or whose stages carry approval=required (paid render / media egress; src/lib/recipe-compiler.ts:167 requiresApproval)

interception.how: The planner catches upstream failures into trace steps and typed degraded results (api/creator-agent.ts); the browser agent maps failures to typed error events (model_auth_failed, openrouter_<status> with detail truncated to 120 chars, openrouter_unreachable).

fallback.description: When the review pass fails or budgets are exhausted, the run returns the accepted draft plan with depthMode single_pass_degraded, a degradedReason, and a resumable durable checkpoint (nodevideo.agent-checkpoint/v1).

slos.rationale: Declared target mirroring the benchmark gate; not yet measured on production traffic (see production-agent.gaps.md).
Declared target; no production measurement pipeline emits this metric yet (see production-agent.gaps.md).
plannerTotalBudgetMs is a hard in-process budget, so run latency cannot exceed it; declared, not measured as a production percentile.

circuitBreaker.onTrip: Per-run only: when every draft attempt inside the 82s plannerTotalBudgetMs fails, the run aborts and surfaces the error/degraded state. There is NO cross-run circuit breaker; a failing provider is re-attempted by every new run (declared gap in production-agent.gaps.md).

costFuse.onTrip: When accumulated prompt+completion tokens reach maxRunTokens, the model review pass is skipped and the run returns the draft with a degraded reason (api/creator-agent.ts runDeepPlanner). Individual calls are fused by max_tokens 900, plannerPassTimeoutMs 28000, and maxInteractiveRunMs 180000.

judgeRegression.command: npm run clip:judge / npm run coach:test — run by a maintainer on demand; NOT wired to commit, PR, or deploy triggers (declared gap).

rollbackOn.rationale: .github/workflows/openrouter-free-models.yml canaries the current winners every 6 hours against the benchmark thresholds.

modelMigration.pinnedModel: google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free and nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free (config/openrouter-free-routing.json selectedModels; fallbackRouter openrouter/free)
